title: The Case of the Midnight Ovens
story: Four a.m. is Rosa's hour, so she was startled to find her ovens already warm and a tray of gingerbread lighthouses cooling on the rack, each with a tiny icing lamp. Five friends know where she hides the bakery's spare key, and each has a different baking specialty. The icing, Rosa admits, is very nearly as good as hers. Who baked at midnight?

texts: The baker known for rolls is five years older than the baker known for brownies.
Ruben is either 75 or 80 years old.
Emil is older than the baker known for brownies.
Of Emil and the baker in the white apron, one is 70 years old and the other is 80 years old.
Gus is older than the baker in the plaid apron.
The baker known for gingerbread is neither 70 nor 75 years old.
The baker known for fudge is exactly 20 years older than the baker in the striped apron.
The baker known for gingerbread is either Emil or Lou.
The baker in the blue apron is either Lou or Mabel.
Of the 70-year-old and the 80-year-old, one bakes in the flowered apron and the other bakes in the white apron.
